title: Categorical and ordered Čech complexes agree after ULift reindexing
statement: Let C be a category of the stated universes, V an object whose over-category has finite products, U:Fin n→Over V a family, and P:Cᵒᵖ→AddCommGrpCat a presheaf. The categorical Čech complex of U after indexing by ULift(Fin n), with coefficients restricted to Over V, is canonically isomorphic to the ordered dependent-function Čech complex [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] of U with coefficients P.

source.place: Tag 099U, condition (3), finite Čech limit reductions; Tags 099T, 01ZM, 01ZN and 07RP. The proof also uses the explicitly named, already proved WeilConjectures and Mathlib declarations.

proof.text: Use cechCochainπ and cechCochainMk to identify categorical product cochains with dependent functions on tuples. Reindex the tuples by ULift.up and ULift.down. Their inverse equations and additivity follow by the product projection formulas.

Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents to these additive equivalences. The formulas cechComplex_d_apply and cechCochainπ_d identify each differential with the same alternating sum indexed by Fin.succAbove; the reindexing commutes definitionally. This proves the complex isomorphism.
